changelog:
- Initial release of crypto-payroll skill, enabling USDC payroll execution on Base via the Spraay Protocol.
- Supports on-chain pay runs for employees and contractors in one transaction; features non-custodial settlement, protocol fee, duplicate-guard, and payment proof.
- Includes endpoints for payroll validation, cost estimation, execution, and supported token lookup.
- Emphasizes required user confirmation, safety steps, and mandatory validation before payroll execution.
- Recurring payroll cycles supported by repeating validation and execution per updated roster.
- Related tools and endpoints for tax, invoicing, escrow, and batch payouts are referenced.
summary: Run payroll in USDC on Base — pay your whole roster of employees and contractors in one transaction via the Spraay gateway. Free roster validation, cost estimates, x402 execution, duplicate-payment protection. Pairs with payroll audit skills: they check, this one pays.
